{{Quote|Name's General Conlath. Used to command Republic forces on Belsavis. Then they moved me here, said I couldn't handle it anymore. Ha! It's the Dread Masters' fault--Sith who terrorize entire armies with fear. Their forces descended on Belsavis, but they couldn't scare me!|General Conlath|<ref name="SWTOR" />}}
'''Conlath''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[General/Legends|General]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] living during the [[Galactic War]]. Around [[3641 BBY]] he was commanding the Republic forces on [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]], when the [[Dread Masters]] [[Invasion of Belsavis|attacked]] the [[Section X]] area, sending the [[Dread Host]] to attack both Republic and the Empire. Many Republic soldiers felt the influence of Dread Masters and Conlath was despite his protests rotated away from Belsavis and send to [[Carrick Station]] for medical evaluation. While examined by the medical droid [[M-2VB]], Conlath asked a Republic hero to combat the Dread Guard forces in Section X.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
General Conlath appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as a Priority Mission Courier for Section X, added in Update 1.5. Conlath and the quest were later removed from the game in Update 4.0, but brought back in Update 5.9.
